title: Q1
description:
Read: Exo 30:1-10, Exo 26:31-35, Lev 16:12-13

The incense altar stands before the veil, in the holy place. On the day, its incense is taken inside so that the cloud covers the mercy seat.

a) The censer is grouped with the holiest. What in the day's use explains that, without moving the altar's ordinary place?
